correctness.rationale: Parity of beta on prime powers forces odd exponents even for every even n. Exact monotone lower-product bounds 1062347/2654208>2/5 and 30808063/59719680>1/2 restrict integer quotient to odd 1 or 3, then modular 3 and the second product eliminate 3; beta(n)<n-1 for n>4 eliminates 1. All quantifiers and arithmetic, including even power-of-two exponents, checked; verifier independently tests certificates and finite samples.

value.rationale: This unconditional infinite structural restriction concerns a named published open problem and rules out every even candidate with at most nine distinct total prime factors, yielding a concrete >2e19 size bound. It is motivated by a sharp natural eight-prime product threshold and a modulo-three obstruction rather than an arbitrary small census.
